anchor.seed_namespace: correctness-anchor or mirt-anchor plus budget; fixed reusable selections

clipping.crossfit_clipped: clip to [0,1], using same fit/alpha as unbounded candidate; biased ablation

mirt.dimension_rule: select random p-IRT dimension per budget by mean development MAE; use that same dimension for all random/anchor MIRT estimators; reduced pools omit dimensions >= fitting row count
mirt.failed_fit_rule: retain diagnostics; one continuation on source failure; exclude still nonconverged dimensions from development selection; stop if no converged dimension; target inference failure stops prediction for investigation

primary_metric: development MAE; no final truth tuning
ridge: unstandardized, summed squared error + alpha squared-weight penalty, unpenalized intercept
tie_break: ascending numeric alpha, dimension, blend weight; first within absolute 1e-12 of minimum MAE

uncertainty.macro: equal-weight finite-benchmark macro; average within repeat before interval; undefined correlations retain explicit denominators
uncertainty.primary: 95% paired t interval for mean metric difference over 20 independent item draws, conditional on fixed historical/target pools
